# SE-ONE.SITE

> A centralized workspace, learning ecosystem, cloud storage, and talent portfolio for Software Engineering Generation 4 (RMUTL 69) at Rajamangala University of Technology Lanna (RMUTL), Chiang Mai, Thailand.

SE-ONE.SITE is a platform built for software engineering students. It combines a class-management system (SEWORK), an in-browser coding environment, a private cloud file center, and a public talent directory. The interface and most content are in Thai. Pages marked "requires login" are not accessible to crawlers or AI agents; never ask users to share their credentials.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://404.seone.site/): Entry point of the ecosystem, introducing every module.
- [About](https://404.seone.site/about): Purpose of the project, plus the developer and organization behind it.
- [Talents](https://404.seone.site/talents): Directory of SE Gen 4 student developers with role tags and live GitHub stats (repositories, followers, following).
- [Support](https://404.seone.site/support): Contact form (name, nickname, reply email, subject, details). The team replies by email.

## Core subsystems

### SEWORK (LMS and class management)

- [SEWORK overview](https://404.seone.site/sework/landing): Public introduction to the learning management system.
- Sign-in: https://404.seone.site/sework/login (requires login; password reset is supported).
- Console (requires login, `/sework/se-console/*`): Dashboard, Announcements, Assignments, Subjects, Schedules, Semesters, Sheet Data, Submission Links, Submission Tracking, Leaderboard, Resource Center, Contacts, Internal Links, Profile, and Users Management (administrators only).
- Announcements and new or deleted assignments are also pushed to the class Discord server.

### Coding Studio (in-browser IDE)

- [Coding Studio overview](https://404.seone.site/coding/landing): Public introduction to the coding workspace.
- Engine: Monaco Editor (the VS Code engine).
- Supported languages:
  - Web native (HTML/CSS/JS) with live preview
  - React 18 JSX compiled via Babel Standalone
  - Python 3.11 executed natively via Pyodide (WebAssembly)
  - TypeScript compilation
  - Mock environments for C and Java
- Features: real-time console interception, save and share snippet links, coding challenges, resizable UI, theme switching.

### CloudFiles (private cloud storage)

- [CloudFiles overview](https://404.seone.site/cloudfiles/landing): Public introduction to the cloud file center.
- Sign-in: https://404.seone.site/cloudfiles/login (requires login with a SEWORK account).
- Features: upload and download files, create folders, password-protect folders (2FA-style), share resources.

## Technology stack

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, React Router
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, Emotion (CSS-in-JS), Lucide Icons
- Backend/BaaS: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime WebSockets, Edge Functions)
- Deployment: Cloudflare Pages
- Progressive Web App: installable, with a service worker for offline app shell and automatic updates
